typography.guidelines: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Headings must use tracking-tight and font-black for an athletic, elite feel. Body uses font-medium with leading-relaxed.

colors.strategy: Deep Obsidian primary background with Volt Yellow/Electric Lime as the default dynamic gym brand color. The system must use CSS variables (e.g. var(--gym-primary)) for all accents so it can be dynamically injected based on the gym's database settings.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant) for the PWA Bottom Nav and Sticky Headers: 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70 border-t border-white/10'. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.
visual_enhancers.qr_container: Treat the QR Code in the PWA like a premium Apple Wallet pass. Encase it in a Glassmorphic card, but the QR code itself MUST have a pure white background and pure black dots for scanner compatibility.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay) to the Auth screens to eliminate digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4' with tight 'gap-4'. Cards must be flat, cardless styling with 1px border-zinc-800.
grids_and_layouts.member_pwa: Mobile-first, responsive stack. Large generous spacing ('p-6', 'p-8'). Content must not feel cramped. Use a fixed bottom navigation bar instead of a sidebar.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use 2x normal spacing. Avoid 'p-4', use 'p-6' or 'p-8' inside dashboard cards to give breathing room.

components.dynamic_qr: Must show a visual countdown ring (SVG stroke-dasharray) that ticks down 5/10/15 seconds, synchronized with the backend. Use a Framer Motion 3D flip animation ('rotateY: 180') when the code refreshes.
components.pwa_install_prompt: Use the 'Tracing Beam' border effect (animated glowing border) on a bottom-sheet modal or top banner to draw attention without breaking the layout.
components.tables: Admin tables must use Shadcn, but customize with left-aligned columns, row-borders only, and sticky headers. No vertical cell dividers.
components.buttons: PWA uses pill-shaped ('rounded-full') for a consumer-app feel. Admin uses crisp rectangular ('rounded-md') for precision.
components.email_editor: Use a clean bento grid for listing email templates. The editor itself should look like a modern rich text area with a dark mode toolbar.

motion.general: Fast, precise, no lag. Use 'transition-transform duration-200 ease-out'.
motion.interactions: All buttons and cards must have an 'active:scale-[0.98]' state. Hover states must explicitly define text and background color changes.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for list items (e.g., access history) using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Text over the dynamic 'primary' color MUST be calculated. If primary is bright (like #E1FF01), text must be black.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. 'data-testid="qr-refresh-timer"').

image_urls.description: Moody gym interior featuring various workout equipment in a spacious industrial setting

media.icons: Use '@phosphor-icons/react'. Use 'duotone' weight for the PWA navigation to feel premium, and 'regular' weight for the dense Admin panel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Structure the project into two distinct layout trees: '/admin' (Sidebar layout for Super Admin & Gym Admin) and '/app' (PWA bottom nav layout for Members).

Setup CSS variables in index.css for '--gym-primary' and '--gym-primary-foreground' so they can be overridden via JS when a gym configuration is loaded to support the requested dynamic multi-tenant branding.
Implement the dynamic QR code using 'qrcode.react' combined with an animated SVG countdown timer.
The Raspberry Pi config page must have mono-spaced fonts for API key displays and clear 'Copy to Clipboard' buttons.
Implement Stripe UI securely, keeping the dark modern aesthetic during the checkout flow.
Make sure all files use .js/.jsx extensions as per project requirements, not .tsx.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
